source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC console, clear SEL, upload data, remove data and repeat under margin.
source_snapshot.criteria: Uploads normally and no BMC SEL error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; identifies manual environment and repeated BMC transfer boundary.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED/CHANGED; refuses arbitrary writes until scratch path, payload, bounds, integrity, capacity and recovery are defined.

old_problem: The previous review treated the missing scratch path, protocol, payload and loop bounds as preventing a review. Those values can be explicit Project Configuration Requirements while the method prohibits any write until they are signed.
disposition_reason: ED-03 allows BMC endpoint/path/account/payload/count to be bound at runtime. ED-09 keeps chamber/rail supervision manual, ED-15 requires signed integrity/capacity/error criteria and ED-17 preserves SEL rather than clearing it. The recovery protects firmware/log partitions and makes this a complete gated review case without guessing a destination.
decision_basis: Directly read Stability row11 all 18 columns, DeepSeek, GPT V2/history3053 and next row12/history3054.
Only an owner-approved scratch filesystem with reserved free space may receive the deterministic hashed payload; firmware, boot and log partitions are excluded.
Each upload must be hash-verified before deletion, with bounded cycles/time/rate and free-space/BMC-health evidence.
The 30/30-minute source estimates are planning values, not authority for an unspecified loop count; the signed profile supplies the bound.
Next row12 identity was directly verified; no BMC write/delete, SEL clear or lab action ran.

test_case.test_name: Bounded BMC scratch-file upload/remove stress at 40C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Exercise repeatable BMC file transfer, integrity verification and removal on an approved scratch path under measured 40C/+5% rails without filling/wearing critical storage or degrading BMC service.
required_package: BMC firmware/storage map and approved scratch path/free-space reserve
Deterministic payload size/content/hash and bounded cycles/duration/rate
Integrity, capacity/wear, service and SEL oracle
Calibrated environment, abort, cleanup and recovery
test_case.test_command: Operator preserves SEL/storage/service baselines and establishes the approved margin. Validate the scratch mount and reserve, then for exactly the signed finite profile upload the fixed payload through the approved authenticated protocol, verify size/hash, record latency/status/free space, remove only that unique test artifact and prove absence. Monitor BMC service/storage/SEL continuously, clean the test namespace, restore nominal environment and verify health.
test_case.expected_result: Every authorized cycle uploads the exact payload, verifies its hash, deletes only the test artifact, maintains reserve and BMC responsiveness, produces no disallowed storage/service/SEL event, and leaves no residue after nominal restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed path/profile, per-cycle integrity and deletion proof, reserve/service/environment evidence and cleanup. A console login, one unverified upload, arbitrary path, unbounded loop, cleared SEL or absence of obvious failure cannot pass.
safety_gate: Never write firmware/boot/log partitions or an unapproved path
Preflight reserve, payload bound and unique namespace
Abort on reserve, wear/service, SEL, thermal/rail or integrity limit
Preserve evidence, clean only test artifacts, restore nominal, no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: On integrity, capacity, service or environment fault, stop new uploads, preserve state, remove only positively identified test artifacts if safe, use approved OOB/BMC recovery, restore nominal environment and do not resume automatically.
